verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Brex serves an llms.txt at developer.brex.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured Brex Developer API table of contents. Several doc pages are also served as markdown (.md) variants, such as index.html.md, webhooks_api.md and mcp.md, which suits agent consumption. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs effectively, and evidence of how complete the llms.txt coverage is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.brex.com/llms.txt # Brex Developer API
Brex uses webhooks to send real-time notifications when events happen in the accounts that you manage.
